name: Pre-launch learning
action: Collect comparable ESO sales daily/regularly; prepare creatives, UTMs and booking-page discovery.

name: Resolution no-paid baseline
action: Once tickets are live, keep paid media off for ~48h and record Resolution seat movement.

name: Wave 1 — geo + creative
action: 3 geos × 2 creatives; broad 20–60 target; keep ad sets separate.
primary_measure: CTR, LPV, verified tickets if available

name: Wave 2 — age refinement
action: Top 2 Wave-1 geos × 2 age bands using the winning creative.

name: Search + retarget validation
action: €40 Search + €30 retargeting only if audience pool is large enough.

name: Scale reserve across 4 Tuesdays
action: Move budget only to cells with measured evidence; reallocate after every Tuesday.
